newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Physicians Resource options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Physicians Resource options.

text.p: Philadelphia Stock Exchange said Tuesday it will list options on Physicians Resource Group Inc on Dec 12.
The options will open with strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2 for expirations in January, February, May and August.
Shares of the company, which provides practice management services, were down 3/4 at 18-7/8 Tuesday afternoon.
Group One Ltd will be the specialist unit for the options. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
